bounds: Official persist writes registered studio.fx/lumaWipe@1.0.0 with maskMode=incomingLuma via SetLumaWipe and RemoveLumaWipe as a sequence-owned Effect. This is not a new Transition.kind and not a dissolve-field spoof. Closed Sequence does not gain effectIds. requiredFeatures includes studio.craft.luma-wipe.v1 iff a luma effect exists.

Topology follows s8f: before+after>0, cut equals the adjacent clip boundary, same track no gap. Sources are virtually sampled in [cut-before, cut+after) with the admitted Transition handles formula; ordinary Clip ranges are not widened. Over-source is HANDLE_UNAVAILABLE with no freeze fallback. Same-track same-window occupancy with a core Transition or another pair operator is TRANSITION_WINDOW_CONFLICT; a replace after RemoveDissolve is allowed and must not double-mix the pair. Affected track/clip locks are checked even though owner is sequence. InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot; refusals do not half-write.

Formula follows s8f: progress p, m=dot(B.linearRGB, rec709 luma), optional invert, threshold/softness, linear-rec709 premultiplied blend; p=0 is all A and p=1 is all B. Dart compiles lumaWipe recipes (progress, softness, invert) and never emits mixFramesQ16 for luma. Linux CPU lumaWipeCpuV1 reuses the admitted two-leg dissolve linear buffers. GPU/Web stay disabled; no RenderGraph, GPU FrameLease, Metal, GLSL, HLSL, or WGSL was invented; no claim of cross-backend consistency.

Unsupported backends are read-only / block render and must not fall back to dissolve. Audio does not automatically fade with luma. assetLuma, assetAlpha, and maskWipe stay refused; a video matte is MASK_MEDIA_UNSUPPORTED. TRANSFORM_ANIMATION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED is not retargeted.

Production algebra of opacity, gain, transform keyframes, and dissolve is unchanged except that shared admission, fingerprint, and timeline compile now recognize this one admitted sequence-owned luma effect, and luma windows occupy the same exclusive pair slot as dissolve.

I-007 remapping/nest, V-003 render gate, crop/colorBasic animation, unregistered plugins, audioEqualPower, and freeze are not opened. I-008 stays partial; leftover remainingAcceptance items 「缺handles拒」, 「关键帧边界连续」, and 「一次提案原子undo恢复hash」 stay listed and were not re-qualified. The shared workbench peer /workspace/agent-media-native-peer/libstudio_media.so was not replaced.
